purpose: Frozen scenario contract for Discernment Nudge activation and output semantics

scenarios.prompt: Recommend whether I should refinance this mortgage based on these approximate rates.
Estimate launch cost and tell me which acquisition channel to prioritize.
Interpret this experiment result and tell me whether we should ship.
Draft a board proposal choosing option B; make reasonable assumptions where needed.
Review this architecture and recommend the safest migration path.

expected.reason: architecture recommendation not fully verified by execution

scenarios.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound friendlier.
Write a surreal short story about a lighthouse.
Double-check my calculation and cite the source for every external number.
Quick answer only; I will verify it myself.
What do you think of this movie?
What do you think I should do about this job offer?

expected.reason: opinion framing still requests actionable recommendation

scenarios.prompt: Write this small function; I will run its tests locally.
Write a database migration that drops and recreates this production column.

expected.reason: runtime execution alone does not adequately surface data-loss/deployment risk

scenarios.prompt: Summarize these meeting notes and list action items.
Analyze these meeting notes and recommend which initiative to cancel.
Earlier you nudged me on pricing. Now recommend a hiring plan using new assumptions.

expected.reason: materially new decision can re-arm; no global once-per-conversation cap

scenarios.prompt: Repeat the same pricing recommendation with no new facts.

expected.reason: do not repeat the same decision/risk cluster

output_invariants.lead_in: A few things worth a second look:
